description: This file contains unit tests for Azure Queue streaming in Orleans, including setup fixtures, various testing scenarios for producer/consumer patterns, and configuration of an in-process test cluster.

classes.name: AQStreamingTests
classes.description: Test suite for Azure Queue streaming in Orleans, including setup fixture and multiple test cases for producer/consumer scenarios.

classes.name: AQStreamingTests.Fixture
classes.description: Fixture class for setting up and tearing down Orleans testing cluster environment, including configuration for Azure Queue Storage.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous cleanup method that clears Azure queues and disposes of the Orleans cluster.

methods.name: InitializeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous initialization method that verifies preconditions, deploys the cluster, and sets up test runner.

methods.name: StreamTest_01_OneProducerGrainOneConsumerGrain
methods.description: Test for single producer grain and single consumer grain.

methods.name: StreamTest_02_OneProducerGrainOneConsumerClient
methods.description: Test for single producer grain and consumer client.

methods.name: StreamTest_03_OneProducerClientOneConsumerGrain
methods.description: Test for producer client and consumer grain.

methods.name: StreamTest_04_OneProducerClientOneConsumerClient
methods.description: Test for producer and consumer both as clients.

methods.name: StreamTest_05_ManyDifferent_ManyProducerGrainsManyConsumerGrains
methods.description: Test involving many producer grains and many consumer grains.

methods.name: StreamTest_06_ManyDifferent_ManyProducerGrainManyConsumerClients
methods.description: Test involving many producer grains and multiple consumer clients.

methods.name: StreamTest_07_ManyDifferent_ManyProducerClientsManyConsumerGrains
methods.description: Test involving many producer clients and multiple consumer grains.

methods.name: StreamTest_08_ManyDifferent_ManyProducerClientsManyConsumerClients
methods.description: Test involving many producer clients and consumer clients.

methods.name: StreamTest_09_ManySame_ManyProducerGrainsManyConsumerGrains
methods.description: Test where multiple grains produce and consume on same streams.

methods.name: StreamTest_10_ManySame_ManyConsumerGrainsManyProducerGrains
methods.description: Test for many grains both producing and consuming.

methods.name: StreamTest_11_ManySame_ManyProducerGrainsManyConsumerClients
methods.description: Test with grains producing and multiple clients consuming.

methods.name: StreamTest_12_ManySame_ManyProducerClientsManyConsumerGrains
methods.description: Test with multiple producer clients and grains consuming.

methods.name: StreamTest_13_SameGrain_ConsumerFirstProducerLater
methods.description: Test where consumer is set up before producer on same grain.

methods.name: StreamTest_14_SameGrain_ProducerFirstConsumerLater
methods.description: Test where producer is set up before consumer on same grain.

methods.name: StreamTest_15_ConsumeAtProducersRequest
methods.description: Test where consumption is triggered at producer's request.

methods.name: StreamTest_16_MultipleStreams_ManyDifferent_ManyProducerGrainsManyConsumerGrains
methods.description: Test with multiple streams and grains.

methods.name: StreamTest_17_MultipleStreams_1J_ManyProducerGrainsManyConsumerGrains
methods.description: Test with multiple streams, one silo join scenario.
